description: This file defines an enum `BinaryProtocolHolder` that manages a singleton instance of `BinaryProtocol`. It provides methods to access and create the singleton instance, encapsulating the creation logic and holding a reference to a `BinaryProtocol` object.

classes.name: BinaryProtocolHolder
classes.description: An enum singleton that holds an instance of `BinaryProtocol`, providing access and creation methods for it.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current `BinaryProtocol` instance held by the singleton.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new `BinaryProtocol` with provided `Logger` and `IoStream`, assigns it to the singleton, and returns it.
